userStories.title: Stateful debater op
acceptanceCriteria: `statefulDebaterOp` is exported from `src/operations/index.ts` with `kind: "run"`, `name: "debate-stateful"`, `stage: "review"`, `session: { role: "debate-stateful", lifetime: "fresh" }`, `config: debateConfigSelector`
`statefulDebaterOp.model(input)` returns `{ agent: input.debater.agent, model: input.debater.model ?? "fast" }`

`statefulDebaterOp.hopBody(initial, ctx)` calls `ctx.send` exactly twice in the round-0 + round-1 success path: once with `initial` (the propose prompt), once with the rebut prompt built from peer proposals
`statefulDebaterOp.hopBody` resolves `ctx.input.proposalBarriers[ctx.input.index]` with the round-0 `TurnResult.output` before awaiting peer barriers

`statefulDebaterOp.hopBody` awaits `Promise.all(proposalBarriers.map(b => b.promise))` raced against `runtime.signal` abort; when `runtime.signal.aborted === true`, it throws `NaxError` with code `CALL_OP_ABORTED` and does not send round 1

`statefulDebaterOp.parse(output, input, _ctx)` returns an object with `success: boolean`, `rebut: string`, and `proposal: string`; `success` is `false` when `output` starts with `Agent "` (the error prefix set by `buildHopCallback`'s catch path), allowing the coordinator to detect silent agent failures without relying on `callOp` throwing
`runStateful(ctx, prompt)` launches `N` parallel `callOp(ctx.callContext, statefulDebaterOp, …)` invocations where `N = resolvedDebaters.length`
`runStateful(ctx, prompt)` bounds concurrent execution by `ctx.callContext.runtime.configLoader.current().debate?.maxConcurrentDebaters ?? 2` (read from full config, not the slice)

When any single `callOp` invocation throws (abort / no-output) OR returns a result with `success: false`, `runStateful` rejects all peer `proposalBarriers` that have not yet resolved (preventing peer deadlock)

`runStateful(ctx, prompt)` returns a `DebateResult` whose `proposals`, `rebuttals`, `debaters`, `outcome`, and `totalCostUsd` fields match the shape produced by the pre-refactor implementation for the same inputs

`raceAgainstAbort` is exported from `src/debate/utils.ts` and re-exported from `src/debate/index.ts`; it has signature `<T>(promise: Promise<T>, signal: AbortSignal, storyId: string | undefined) => Promise<T>` and throws `NaxError("CALL_OP_ABORTED")` on abort
`runStateful`'s coordinator builds `proposePrompt` and rebuttal prompts via `DebatePromptBuilder` — no multi-line prompt strings assembled inline
`src/debate/runner-stateful.ts` contains no references to `sessionManager.openSession`, `sessionManager.closeSession`, `agentManager.runAsSession`, `resolveModelDefForDebater`, or `ctx.config.models`
The refactored `runner-stateful.ts` contains no property access on `ctx.config.models` or `DebateConfig["models"]`
suggestedCriteria: When `raceAgainstAbort` is called with an already-aborted `AbortSignal`, it throws `NaxError` with code `CALL_OP_ABORTED` immediately without awaiting the wrapped promise

When fewer than 2 debaters succeed (the existing fallback threshold), `runStateful` returns a `DebateResult` with `outcome: "skipped"` and a populated `debaters` list reflecting only the successful debaters
When all `callOp` invocations return `success: false`, `runStateful` returns a `DebateResult` with `outcome: "failed"` without deadlocking
When `ctx.callContext.runtime.configLoader.current().debate?.maxConcurrentDebaters` is undefined, coordinator defaults to `2` concurrent debaters
Every `logger.*` call in `runner-stateful.ts` coordinator code places `storyId` as the first key in the data object

userStories.title: Hybrid debater op
acceptanceCriteria: `hybridDebaterOp` is exported from `src/operations/index.ts` with `kind: "run"`, `name: "debate-hybrid"`, `stage: "review"`, `session: { role: "debate-hybrid", lifetime: "fresh" }`, `config: debateConfigSelector`
`hybridDebaterOp.hopBody` performs the N-round rebuttal loop with one `ctx.send` per round and a per-round peer-barrier `await` between rounds
`hybridDebaterOp.hopBody` resolves the current round's barrier with each turn's output before awaiting the next round's peer barriers
`runHybrid(ctx, prompt)` launches `N` parallel `callOp(ctx.callContext, hybridDebaterOp, …)` invocations
When any single `callOp` invocation throws OR returns a result with `success: false`, `runHybrid` rejects all unresolved peer barriers across all rounds
When `hybridDebaterOp.hopBody` receives an abort signal between rebuttal rounds, it throws `NaxError` with code `CALL_OP_ABORTED` without sending further turns
`runHybrid(ctx, prompt)` returns a `DebateResult` whose shape matches the pre-refactor implementation for the same inputs
`runHybrid`'s coordinator builds prompts via `DebatePromptBuilder` — no multi-line prompt strings assembled inline
`src/debate/runner-hybrid.ts` contains no references to `sessionManager.openSession`, `sessionManager.closeSession`, `agentManager.runAsSession`, `resolveModelDefForDebater`, or `ctx.config.models`
suggestedCriteria: When `rounds` is configured to 1 in debate config, `hybridDebaterOp.hopBody` calls `ctx.send` exactly twice (proposal + one rebut round)
When a debater fails in round 2 of 3, barriers for rounds 2 and 3 are both rejected (not just the current round's barriers)
Every `logger.*` call in `runner-hybrid.ts` coordinator code places `storyId` as the first key in the data object

userStories.title: Plan debater op and verifier-pick patch via signal
acceptanceCriteria: `planDebaterOp` is exported from `src/operations/index.ts` with `kind: "run"`, `name: "debate-plan"`, `stage: "plan"`, `session: { role: "debate-plan", lifetime: "fresh" }`, `config: debateConfigSelector`
`planDebaterOp.hopBody` accepts `selectionSignal: Promise<{ patchPrompt?: string }>` on `input`
After sending the rebut turn, `planDebaterOp.hopBody` awaits `selectionSignal` raced against `runtime.signal` abort

When `selectionSignal` resolves with `{ patchPrompt }` where `patchPrompt` is a non-empty string, `planDebaterOp.hopBody` calls `ctx.send(patchPrompt)` exactly once and returns that turn's `TurnResult`
When `selectionSignal` resolves with `{}` or `{ patchPrompt: undefined }`, `planDebaterOp.hopBody` returns the rebut `TurnResult` without an extra send
`runPlan(ctx, taskContext, outputFormat, opts)` constructs N `PromiseWithResolvers<{ patchPrompt?: string }>` and launches N parallel `callOp(ctx.callContext, planDebaterOp, …)` invocations

After all `callOp` invocations resolve their proposal+rebut output, `runPlan` runs scoring (delegating to the existing verifier-pick scoring helpers) and when patch is enabled in `stageConfig.selector` (kind `"verifier-pick"`) and runner-up overlap < `overlapThreshold`, resolves the winner's signal with `{ patchPrompt }` and losers' signals with `{}`
When patch is disabled or overlap >= threshold, `runPlan` resolves all signals with `{}`

When the winner's patch turn fails (`ctx.send` for patch prompt throws), `runPlan` returns a `DebateResult` using the pre-patch rebut output as the winner contribution (no re-throw, no undefined result)
`runPatchStep` in `verifier-pick.ts` does not call `agentManager.runAsSession`
`runPatchStep` in `verifier-pick.ts` returns `Promise<string>` and only builds/returns the patch prompt
`verifierPickSelector` no longer dispatches patch turns internally via `runPatchStep`
`SuccessfulProposal` interface in `src/debate/session-helpers.ts` no longer declares a `handle` field
`verifier-pick.ts` does not throw `NaxError` with code `VERIFIER_PICK_NO_HANDLE`
`runPlan`'s coordinator builds prompts via `DebatePromptBuilder` — no multi-line prompt strings assembled inline

`src/debate/runner-plan.ts` and `src/debate/runner-plan-helpers.ts` contain no references to `sessionManager.openSession`, `sessionManager.closeSession`, `agentManager.runAsSession`, `resolveModelDefForDebater`, or `ctx.config.models`
suggestedCriteria: When `selectionSignal` itself rejects (not resolves with empty), `planDebaterOp.hopBody` propagates the rejection as a `NaxError` with code `CALL_OP_ABORTED`
When `planDebaterOp.hopBody` receives an already-aborted signal before sending the rebut turn, it throws `NaxError` with code `CALL_OP_ABORTED` without sending the rebut
Every `logger.*` call in `runner-plan.ts` coordinator code places `storyId` as the first key in the data object

userStories.title: Delete legacy helpers and slim debateConfigSelector
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Delete `resolveDebaterModel`, `resolveModelDefForDebater`, and `runComplete` from `src/debate/session-helpers.ts`; remove `"models"` from `debateConfigSelector`; update the adapter-wiring session role registry to reflect Phase 2 landing.

**Motivation** — These three functions exist solely to wrap the Layer-3/2 escape hatch that US-003/004/005 eliminated. `debateConfigSelector` still includes `"models"` purely to satisfy `DebateConfig.models` readers in those helpers — once they go, the slice shrinks to its minimal two-key shape.

**Approach** — Deletions (after US-003/004/005 all land, so no remaining callers):

1. Delete `resolveDebaterModel` (lines 100-110), `resolveModelDefForDebater` (lines 165-183), and `runComplete` (lines 139-151) from `src/debate/session-helpers.ts`.
2. Delete unused imports from `session-helpers.ts`: `resolveConfiguredModel`, `resolveModelForAgent`, `ModelsConfig`, `ModelDef`, `DEFAULT_CONFIG` (if no other reader).
3. Remove re-exports of the deleted symbols from `src/debate/index.ts`.
4. Change `src/config/selectors.ts:44` from:
   ```typescript
   export const debateConfigSelector = pickSelector("debate", "debate", "models", "agent");
   ```
   to:
   ```typescript
   export const debateConfigSelector = pickSelector("debate", "debate", "agent");
   ```
5. Delete the `resolveDebaterModel` test block from `test/unit/debate/runner-events.test.ts`.
6. Update any tests that build a `DebateConfig` literal to drop the `models` field.
7. Update `.claude/rules/adapter-wiring.md` session role registry: move `"debate-stateful"`, `"debate-hybrid"`, `"debate-plan"` from the `agentManager.runAsSession` row to the `callOp` run-kind row; update the `debate-${string}` template-literal carve-out in the sanctioned-consumers prose to note Phase 2 landing.

The type system acts as the safety net: after removing `"models"` from the selector, any remaining `DebateConfig["models"]` reader fails `bun run typecheck` — the desired signal that a site was missed.

`DebateConfig` post-change shape: `{ debate: NaxConfig["debate"]; agent: NaxConfig["agent"] }`. Compile-time assertion verifiable via a `satisfies` or `type` test that the derived type has exactly `"debate" | "agent"` as keys.

**Scope** — In: `src/debate/session-helpers.ts` (delete 3 functions + unused imports), `src/debate/index.ts` (remove re-exports), `src/config/selectors.ts` (slim selector), `test/unit/debate/runner-events.test.ts` (delete resolveDebaterModel test block), other test fixtures using `DebateConfig` literal (drop `models` field), `.claude/rules/adapter-wiring.md` (update registry). Out: resolveOutcome, pipelineStageForDebate, ResolvedDebater, ResolveOutcome — these are NOT deleted.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/debate/session-helpers.ts` no longer exports `resolveDebaterModel`
`src/debate/session-helpers.ts` no longer exports `resolveModelDefForDebater`
`src/debate/session-helpers.ts` no longer exports `runComplete`
`src/debate/session-helpers.ts` does not import `resolveConfiguredModel` or `resolveModelForAgent`

`src/debate/index.ts` no longer re-exports the deleted symbols (`resolveDebaterModel`, `resolveModelDefForDebater`, `runComplete`)
Importing `resolveDebaterModel`, `resolveModelDefForDebater`, or `runComplete` from `@/debate` fails TypeScript compilation
`debateConfigSelector` in `src/config/selectors.ts` equals `pickSelector("debate", "debate", "agent")` (no `"models"` argument)
`DebateConfig` derived type has exactly the keys `"debate" | "agent"` (verified at compile time via a type-assertion test or `satisfies` check)
No file under `src/debate/` references `config.models`, `ctx.config.models`, or `DebateConfig["models"]`
Test fixtures and helpers that previously constructed a `DebateConfig` literal with a `models` field are updated to drop that field
`test/unit/debate/runner-events.test.ts` does not contain any `describe`/`test` block exercising `resolveDebaterModel`

`.claude/rules/adapter-wiring.md` session role registry: `"debate-stateful"`, `"debate-hybrid"`, `"debate-plan"` are moved from the `agentManager.runAsSession` row to the `callOp` run-kind row; the `debate-${string}` template-literal carve-out in the sanctioned-consumers prose is updated to note Phase 2 landing
suggestedCriteria: When a test constructs a `DebateConfig` with a `models` field after the selector slim, TypeScript emits an excess-property error

analysis:
Phase 2 of 2 of the debate callOp migration. Phase 1 migrated the resolver ops (judge/synthesis) and added SelectorContext.callContext threading. This phase migrates the three stateful runners and deletes legacy helpers.

CURRENT STATE:
- src/debate/runner-stateful.ts: Coordinator that pre-opens N session handles, runs allSettledBounded for proposals (parallel, concurrency-bounded), then a critique round. Directly calls sessionManager.openSession/closeSession + agentManager.runAsSession. Finally block closes all handles.
- src/debate/runner-hybrid.ts: Same pre-open pattern + N-round rebuttal loop via runRebuttalLoop(). Dual handle ownership: pre-opened handles for proposal round, internally-opened handles for rebuttal-only mode (used when proposal.handle is missing). Caller-managed vs internal handles tracked separately.
- src/debate/runner-plan.ts: Two code paths — stateful (pre-opened handles via openPlanSessions()) and one-shot (sessionManager.runInSession()). Writes plan output to disk, reads back. Unique post-debate verifier phase. Uses runner-plan-helpers.ts for session lifecycle abstraction.
- src/debate/runner-plan-helpers.ts: openPlanSessions, closePlanSessions, runStatefulPlanTurn, makeStatefulProposal helpers. Delegates to resolveModelDefForDebater for model resolution.
- src/debate/session-helpers.ts: SuccessfulProposal interface (lines 30-39) includes optional handle field (line 38). resolveDebaterModel (lines 102-112), resolveModelDefForDebater (lines 167-183), runComplete (lines 141-153) — all to be deleted in US-006. resolveOutcome (lines 215-348) is the multi-selector orchestrator and is NOT deleted.
- src/debate/selectors/verifier-pick.ts: runPatchStep (lines 127-148) calls ctx.agentManager.runAsSession with winner.proposal.handle. Throws NaxError("VERIFIER_PICK_NO_HANDLE") when no handle (lines 136-141). verifierPickSelector falls back to unpatched on runPatchStep failure.
- src/config/selectors.ts:44: debateConfigSelector = pickSelector("debate", "debate", "models", "agent") — "models" removed after US-006.

REFACTOR SHAPE:
Runner becomes a coordinator: builds per-debater inputs (PromiseWithResolvers barriers, prompt builders), launches N parallel callOp(callContext, debaterOp, input) invocations via allSettledBounded, aggregates results. Per-debater session lifecycle moves into debaterOp.hopBody — buildHopCallback owns open/close, hopBody executes turns within the warm session.

BARRIER PATTERN (critical):
Each debater's hopBody resolves its own proposalBarriers[i] with round-0 output BEFORE awaiting Promise.all(proposalBarriers) raced against abort signal. Coordinator MUST reject all unresolved barriers when any callOp invocation throws OR returns success:false — otherwise peers deadlock indefinitely waiting for a barrier that will never resolve. This is the single most critical correctness requirement.

SESSION LIFECYCLE:
buildHopCallback (src/operations/build-hop-callback.ts:170-282) opens session before hopBody runs, closes in finally. Between ctx.send() calls, session stays warm. This preserves working-memory semantics that stateful debate relies on (each debater sees its own prior turns when generating round 1).

VERIFIER-PICK PATCH REFACTOR (US-005):
Current: runPatchStep builds prompt + calls agentManager.runAsSession with winner.proposal.handle.
After: runPatchStep is reduced to building the patch prompt from winner.proposal.output + deltas and returning it to the coordinator. Coordinator resolves winner's selectionSignal with { patchPrompt }, winner's planDebaterOp.hopBody sends one more ctx.send(patchPrompt) inside its still-open session. SuccessfulProposal.handle field is removed entirely.

COST: callOp run-kind does not surface estimatedCostUsd in parsed O. Coordinators use cost: 0 per debater op result (interim, tracked in issue #1036). Full rollup deferred.

NEW FILES TO CREATE:
- src/operations/debate-stateful.ts (US-003)
- src/debate/utils.ts with raceAgainstAbort (US-003)
- src/operations/debate-hybrid.ts (US-004)
- src/operations/debate-plan.ts (US-005)

FILES TO MODIFY:
- src/debate/runner-stateful.ts (coordinator rewrite, US-003)
- src/debate/runner-hybrid.ts (coordinator rewrite, US-004)
- src/debate/runner-plan.ts (coordinator rewrite, US-005)
- src/debate/runner-plan-helpers.ts (remove session calls, US-005)
- src/debate/selectors/verifier-pick.ts (remove agentManager.runAsSession, US-005)
- src/debate/session-helpers.ts (delete 3 functions + handle field, US-006)
- src/debate/index.ts (update re-exports, US-006)
- src/config/selectors.ts (remove "models" from debateConfigSelector, US-006)
- src/operations/index.ts (add new op exports, US-003/004/005)
- test/unit/debate/runner-events.test.ts (delete resolveDebaterModel test block, US-006)
- .claude/rules/adapter-wiring.md (move debate-stateful/hybrid/plan to callOp row, US-006)

RISKS:
1. Deadlock if coordinator fails to reject peer barriers on debater failure. Every failure path (callOp throw + success:false result) must trigger barrier rejection.
2. SuccessfulProposal.handle removal breaks verifier-pick's current patch path — US-005 must completely replace that dispatch before US-006 removes the field.
3. Context threading: coordinators use ctx.callContext (from SelectorContext, added Phase 1) for callOp dispatch. Do not pass ctx directly.
4. DebateConfig type erasure: removing "models" from selector causes compile-time failures on any remaining readers — desired safety net.
5. Bun barrier semantics: Promise.withResolvers() is Bun native — used per spec. The .promise field on a PromiseWithResolvers is a Promise<T>, not T, so parse() stub's cast is intentional as a placeholder.

TEST REFERENCE: test/unit/debate/runner-events.test.ts tests debate:start/proposal/result/fallback event emissions — must continue to pass post-refactor. The resolveDebaterModel test block is deleted in US-006.
